title: Config load failure hides joined mount namespace, sends users chasing filesystem errors
body:
### Issue Description

Rootless `podman` fails at startup for every command with:

```
Failed to obtain podman configuration: open /media/.../storage.conf: input/output error
```

while the same file reads fine with coreutils (`md5sum`, `cat`, direct-I/O `dd`), repeatedly — podman fails 100% of runs, all other readers succeed 100%.

Root cause (verified against v6.1.1 sources): the C constructor in `pkg/rootless/rootless_linux.c` ([`init()`](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/8303f2e25b675ea7f82099d615c60969aec15870/pkg/rootless/rootless_linux.c#L720), [shortcut at ~L812](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/8303f2e25b675ea7f82099d615c60969aec15870/pkg/rootless/rootless_linux.c#L812)) joins an existing user+mount namespace via `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/libpod/tmp/ns_handles` or `pause.pid` **before** Go `main()` runs, for every command except the [`can_use_shortcut` denylist](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/8303f2e25b675ea7f82099d615c60969aec15870/pkg/rootless/rootless_linux.c#L606-L644). My pause holder predated a USB device re-enumeration (sdb→sda), so its mount namespace referenced a dead superblock instance; every config `open()` went through the ghost mount and got EIO. In the load path ([`types/options.go`](https://github.com/containers/storage/blob/83cf57466529353aced8f1803f2302698e0b5cb7/types/options.go#L154-L176)) [`faccessat`](https://github.com/containers/storage/blob/83cf57466529353aced8f1803f2302698e0b5cb7/types/options.go#L154-L156) and `stat` succeed and only the `os.Open` inside [`toml.DecodeFile`](https://github.com/containers/storage/blob/83cf57466529353aced8f1803f2302698e0b5cb7/types/options.go#L413-L427) fails — matching the `open ...: input/output error` text. `strace` confirms a plain `openat(AT_FDCWD, <abspath>, O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC)`, so flags, cwd, and permissions are all exonerated; the error names the file but says nothing about the joined namespace that made it unreadable.

Only *dead* pause PIDs self-clean ([`check_stale_pause_pid`](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/8303f2e25b675ea7f82099d615c60969aec15870/pkg/rootless/rootless_linux.c#L686-L704) unlinks `pause.pid` for recycled PIDs; stale `ns_handles` fail with ESTALE). A *live* pause process with a *dead* mount view is unhandled.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

1. Have a pause holder whose mount namespace predates a device re-enumeration (e.g. a long-lived pause process surviving a USB replug that renames sdb1→sda1), so `pause.pid` points at a live process with a stale mount view.
2. Run any non-denylisted rootless command, e.g. `podman info` or `podman build`.
3. Observe the config-load EIO while `md5sum` on the same path succeeds.

### Describe the results you received

`Failed to obtain podman configuration: open .../storage.conf: input/output error` on every run, for every command except the shortcut-denylisted ones.

### Describe the results you expected

Either (a) validate the joined namespace's view before using it, or (b) on config-load failure, report the namespace context: mnt-ns id, join source (`pause.pid` value / `ns_handles`), and the config path attempted — so users don't chase filesystem errors for a namespace problem.

### podman info output

Unable to run `podman info` — that command itself hits the reported failure. Environment: rootless Linux, `CONTAINERS_STORAGE_CONF` on an ntfs3 USB mount; behavior verified against v6.1.1 sources ([`cmd/podman/registry/config.go:98`](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/8303f2e25b675ea7f82099d615c60969aec15870/cmd/podman/registry/config.go#L98), [`containers/storage` `types/options.go`](https://github.com/containers/storage/blob/83cf57466529353aced8f1803f2302698e0b5cb7/types/options.go#L154-L176), [`pkg/rootless/rootless_linux.c`](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/8303f2e25b675ea7f82099d615c60969aec15870/pkg/rootless/rootless_linux.c#L720)). Exact `podman version` string not captured at filing time.

### Podman in a container

No

### Privileged Or Rootless

Rootless

### Upstream Latest Release

No

### Additional environment details

Rootless Linux amd64; storage on removable ntfs3 USB media that re-enumerated while a pause process from the earlier enumeration stayed alive; XDG_RUNTIME_DIR on tmpfs.

### Additional information

`dmesg` showed repeated `ntfs3(sdb1): failed to read volume at offset ...` from the stale instance (the live mount is sda1). Stopping the stale pause scope (`systemctl --user stop podman-pause-<id>.scope`) resolved it: the next run self-cleaned `pause.pid` and opened the config in the live namespace.
